(section) K.S.A. 25-2316c(a)(5): correction of lists on jury-service non-citizen notice
(quote) (5) notice is provided by a jury commissioner pursuant to K.S.A. 43-162, and amendments thereto, or by the appropriate officer of a federal court that a registered voter is not eligible for jury service due to such individual not being a citizen of the United States.
(other) New Sec. 1: courts report noncitizen jury ineligibility to the county election office (K.S.A. 43-162).
(note) Off this topic: the bill sets no ID or citizenship-proof rule.
